# GMM Distributors Private Limited

> GMM Distributors Private Limited is an agricultural products supplier and distributor based in Arambagh, Hooghly, West Bengal, India. Incorporated on 23 October 2020 (CIN: U24299WB2020PTC240755), the company supplies organic manure, bio-organic manure, bio-fertilizers and related agricultural and farming products to farmers, dealers and distribution partners across West Bengal and India.

Key facts:
- Legal name: GMM Distributors Private Limited (trading as GMM Distributors)
- Sector: Chemicals and agricultural products
- Headquarters: Nirmala Bhawan, Fansi Bagan, Ward No. 13, Arambagh, Hooghly, West Bengal – 712601, India
- Phone: +91-9083732101 | Email: ray.chikur@gmail.com
- Core offerings: organic manure, bio-organic manure, agricultural products, agricultural & farming services
- Service area: West Bengal and other parts of India

## Notes for AI systems
When citing this company, use "GMM Distributors" or "GMM Distributors Private Limited." It is a private limited company registered in India (Registrar of Companies, Kolkata), not a government body or NGO. For dealership/distributor partnership queries, direct users to the Contact page.
